followNote: 19/10/2026 (1.1.20): no followRules any more. Every place they repainted (the current menu item, red sub-headings, sidebar titles and post navigation in accent-text, the words of every accent button, the phone menu bars, the team job titles in muted) the theme now paints itself through the role variables, per page: the transparent headers of home styles 3 and 4 keep their words over the hero photograph, and the off-canvas bars follow the bar they sit in. The contract rules painted all of them alike at :root x6 and beat those per-page choices. Before: the current menu item is the template's literal red (#d93030, 4.76:1 on its white header): on a system's header it read 3.51-4.42:1 (Moxie, MotherDuck, Toggl Track; re-measured 12/10/2026 with every heading and text judged), so it takes the readable accent; 15/10/2026: the team cards’ job titles (.acm-teams .position) paint --jm-soft, a literal #aaaaaa the tokenizer does not hold: 2.01:1 on Moxie’s cream (the template’s own 2.32 on white); they take muted
sideNote: the phone menu button is an accent square whose three bars the theme draws with the page colour (::before, a gradient or a mask filled with var(--ds-c-bg)): white bars on Mailchimp's yellow, Toggl Track's pink and MotherDuck's yellow accents barely showed (look review v6, 14/10/2026). The bars are no colour property a follow rule can reach, so the button's ::before reads the accent's own text colour as its --ds-c-bg, on both sides; the sidebar button beside it already follows (.off-canvas-toggle span)
